title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 17 September 2026
description: Today: oil prices spike on a Saudi supply disruption and a century-old murder hotel hits the market in WA; a Brisbane BMX rider's Scientology speedrun stunt lands him in court alongside a serious pedestrian assault case; and a revamped Gold Coast bus network rolls out as part of a $543m transport investment. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
